title: Tool claims 5x faster pageable cudaMemcpy on NVIDIA B300
summary: A Reddit author \(/u/makneeee\) released an open-source tuner, cudamemcpy-tuner, that claims to speed up pageable cudaMemcpy transfers on an NVIDIA B300. In the posted benchmark, copying a 1 GB uint8 tensor from CPU to GPU ran at 10.2 GB/s unmodified and 51.5 GB/s after wrapping the same script with \`cmt tune -- python bench.py\`. The claim covers only pageable CPU-to-GPU copies on a single GPU model, comes from the author&\#x27;s own unrun-by-others measurement, and the terse post defers technical detail to a linked blog and the GitHub repository; no independent verification is provided.
